title: Flow Library drawer: no licence attribution row for gated models
description: MpiModelManager detail drawer renders the licence name, the required poweredBy attribution and the licence/authorization/report links. MpiFlowLibrary slide-over has no equivalent. H3 SIII.3.a and SIV.2 owe attribution on the surface where the model is PRESENTED, and a Flow user may never open the Model Library. Affects every gated model reached via a Flow, not just H3. Consent is NOT affected: the acceptance gate fires via downloadService.start for all install paths.
